recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a single hosted Healthchecks.io dead man's switch: the script pings it at the end of each successful run, and the user gets an email or push if no ping arrives.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to be told when the sync fails. Nobody asked for log storage.
labels.Deleted: Central log on the Synology, Docker, and log aggregation. You won't read logs, and a log can't tell you about a run that never happened.
labels.Bottleneck: Nothing alerts on *absence*. The only signal is the success email, so a dead job is silent.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you told me: cron runs it at 03:00 on `edna`, the email is the last step, it crashed before that step four nights running, and nothing else alerts. I haven't seen the script or crontab.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert, rejects the Synology/Docker logging stack, and places all four specific record lines before the recommendation.
